## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant issue. For a sync change, include the device/action ordering that reproduces the problem.

## Validation

Record the focused checks and release gate actually run. Distinguish local simulations from hosted, Obsidian and physical-device results. Do not include credentials, private notes or generated release artifacts.

## Compatibility and recovery

For protocol, schema, parser or browser-storage changes, state supported upgrade/downgrade behavior, preserved pending intent, and rollback requirements. Otherwise state “No format change.”
